If I pretended to believe comfort should come before honesty, I'd literally be being dishonest to make you comfortable, which is exactly what I just said I don't want to do. That wouldn't be good for either of us.

You're welcome to disagree with me, and tell me why you see it differently. I'd rather have that real disagreement than fake agreement.
